description:
Broaden OpenAI support across the Responses API HTTP lane for representative low-cost and current models.

Scope:
- support the practical Responses HTTP surface for current OpenAI models we can handle cleanly
- validate object generation, tool calls, image input, reasoning, and usage extraction where applicable
- keep the shared semantic path aligned across models so the execution plan remains the main source of variation
- isolate true OpenAI quirks into policy or adapters only when needed
title: Expand OpenAI Responses HTTP support across representative models
